notes: The Plus2 is the StickC-Plus chassis (M5Stack publishes no Plus2 file): only its color and its back label differ, so this spec takes the StickC-Plus STL and gives it the Plus2's yellow case and printed back label. The STL holds the device twice over (the assembly at x = -12..12 mm and an exploded copy); only the assembly is kept: the front shell (window, BtnA flex tongue, power-key tongue) and the back shell (BtnB tongue, label recess, header pocket, Grove slot, screw counterbores). It is a shell only, so the display, the USB-C, the Grove housing, the HAT header, the inserts, the screws, the opaque interior and the label are added here from measurements.json and the vendor photos. The STL faces its back to +Z with the device's right at -X, so it is turned 180 degrees about Y and moved so the body spans x 0..24, y 0..48 (y up the screen) and z -13.5..0 (the front at 0). The model's origin is the center of that 24 x 48 x 13.5 mm body.

source.license_note: MIT (the repository's LICENSE). The STL is not redistributed: only its address and digest are recorded, and the model's asset.copyright names it. It is the StickC-Plus file: the Plus2 shares that chassis and M5Stack publishes no file of its own for it.

volumes.note: fill: the opaque interior every opening shows (the main interior behind the front plate, which the back plate's slope at the bottom end limits to z -10 below y 9.6, and the two corners beside the Grove slot, above the screw counterbores). lcd: the LCD module behind the window, under the front plate's inner face at z -1.2.

meshes.name: glass
meshes.note: The visible glass of front.svg (x 4.49..19.51, y 3.455..28.525 down from the top), just behind the window's 14.8 x 24.86 mm inner edge.

meshes.name: usb_c_shell
meshes.note: The USB-C receptacle in the bottom end (front-shell opening x 7.39..16.61, z -1.1..-4.5).

meshes.name: grove_base
meshes.note: The black strip between the USB-C and the Grove housing, across the slot's front-shell part (x 5.9..18.1, z -4.5..-6.5).

meshes.name: grove
meshes.note: The HY2.0-4P (Grove) housing in the bottom-end slot, its socket facing the end: front, side, back and inner walls around an 8.9 x 4.2 mm socket.

meshes.name: header
meshes.note: The 1x8 HAT female header in the back shell's top pocket (x 1.5..22.5, ledge at z -10.9), its face 0.02 mm inside the top end; the label covers it below y 46.93. Its face spans the eight contacts' funnels (x 2.36..21.64) and its two ends stop at y 47.6, under the case's R3 corners, so it stands at most 0.05 mm outside the case's outline.

meshes.name: header_funnels
meshes.note: Each contact: a funneled 1.5 mm entry around a 0.8 mm dark hole.

meshes.name: back_label
meshes.note: The back label in its 0.2 mm recess (x 1.5..22.5 from y 9.4 up), over the header up to 1.07 mm from the top end: the vendor photo's black band over the label is 1.07 mm deep, and its paper 1.787 times as long as it is wide.

meshes.name: label_legends
meshes.note: What back.svg prints on the back label (its back-label group): the eight pin cells and their names, the M5StickC PLUS2 banner, the chips, the ESP32, battery, IMU and RTC blocks with their text, the LCD and MIC lines, the model name and FCC ID, the FCC, CE, WEEE, Giteki and Espressif marks, M5Stack's cube and lines, the HY2.0-4P cells and PWR. Laid on the label's face (z -13.46) facing -Z, three position steps out of it, inside the shell's recess.

meshes.name: inserts
meshes.note: The two brass inserts at the label's lower corners, in the back plate's holes (r 0.75).

meshes.name: screws
meshes.note: The two silver screws in the bottom counterbores (r 1.95, floor at z -9.05).
